name: @workspace/api-mocks
//exports: Three entry points, each for a consumer that must not pay for the others. `./fixtures` is deliberately free of any msw import so the Playwright runner — which keeps its own interception and wants only the payloads — never loads an interceptor it will not use. `./node` is the one place msw/node is named, which is what keeps the environment choice out of every other file.
